{"consolidated_memory":"CACHE MISS STORMS IN build/bazel/BUILD.bazel (Two Occasions)

Both incidents involved cache miss storms in build/bazel/BUILD.bazel. Same corner of the build system, context carried over between them.

OCCASION 1: 2026-01-20
- Affected: Sessions arriving through the OAuth provider
- Repro: Build twice with no source change
- Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Signal: Rebuild of targets that should have been cached
- Outcome: Alert stayed quiet for 60 consecutive days
- Fix: Added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #4146, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-1

OCCASION 2: 2026-05-31
- Affected: Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Repro: Build twice with no source change
- Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Signal: Rebuild of targets that should have been cached
- Outcome: 48 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #6419, branch fix/cache-miss-storm-6"}
